scope: Actual PostgreSQL authorization migration + real consent policy + delegate boundary probes; not a complete Places/save integration
tests: original delegate bodies are unchanged and inaccessible to client roles
unqualified caller reaches none of the three mutation delegates
qualified owner retains original RPC return contracts and writes
original owner validation remains effective after authorization
withdrawn AI permission rejects all mutation entrypoints without a write
new legal revision invalidates stale acceptance before writes
anonymous direct execution and helper bypass are denied
save first locks consent through commit; concurrent withdrawal commits afterward
withdrawal first makes a waiting save recheck current consent and write nothing
